name: Joint Reconstruction Training Losses
definition: An end-to-end per-scene optimization that jointly reconstructs scene geometry and appearance properties modeled by tensor factorization, supervised by rendering losses, normal regularization, and other regularizations.
summary: Joint Reconstruction Training Losses is a composite objective function that jointly optimizes scene geometry and appearance in tensor factorization-based inverse rendering by correlating shading normals with density fields to reduce overfitting.
